_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
O oe o Pela {player_id} i Tic Tac Toe.
O lou faʻamoemoe o laka lea ni tolu i le faʻatasia (i le itu, i le pito, poʻo i le tasi) i luga o le pati.
I lou taimi, e tatau ona e filifili le numera o le selo (0-8) e te manaʻo e tuu ai lou faʻailoga i le afa itulau.
Mo se faʻataʻitaʻiga, '[4]' e tuu ai lou faʻailoga i le selo pokopiko o le pati.
O ā mai o Pela {player_id}, e te faʻaigoa ai o ia ko '{symbol}', a o lou fili e faʻaigoa ai o ia ko '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E lē o saʻo le faatulagaga ua tuuina mai.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} e lē o se sela saʻo. E tatau ona i le va 0 ma 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ua uma ona nofoia le sela {cell}.

game_action.placed: Pela {player_id} na tuu lana faʻailoga ({symbol}) i totonu o selo {cell}.
